scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.db:reset: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),d='backend/data';if(fs.existsSync(d))for(const f of fs.readdirSync(d))if(/[.]db(-wal|-shm)?$/.test(f))fs.rmSync(d+'/'+f)" && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
